newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CHELSEA SIGN BABAYARO FROM ANDERLECHT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHELSEA SIGN BABAYARO FROM ANDERLECHT.

text.p: English F.A. Cup finalists Chelsea signed Nigerian defender Celestine Babayaro from Belgium's Anderlecht on Monday for 2.25 million pounds ($3.7 million).
Babayaro, a member of Nigeria's Olympic gold medal winning side in Atlanta, will join the London club on a five-year contract at the end of the season.
"I've talked to (Chelsea player-manager Ruud Gullit) twice now...he said he'd be glad to have me in his team," said the 18-year-old left wing-back, who made his debut for Anderlecht at 15.
Chelsea beat off competition from Inter Milan and Juventus to sign Babayaro who scored three goals in Atlanta, including one in the final.
